prompt: In the Splice project {project}, add a custom animated lower-third built with HTML and CSS: it slides in from the left at second 1, reads 'Splice demo', and stays for 4 seconds. Check that it renders, using the splice MCP tools only.

checks.name: an HTML overlay
checks.expr: any(i['kind'] == 'media' and str(media.get(i['params']['media'], {}).get('path', '')).startswith('media/html-') for i in items)

checks.name: about 4 s
checks.expr: any(i['kind'] == 'media' and str(media.get(i['params']['media'], {}).get('path', '')).startswith('media/html-') and 100 <= i['length'] <= 140 for i in items)
